% 04.11.2025 CRL.M.A. 32429/2025 (delay 98 days in filing of appeal)
Bearing in mind the reasons explained in para nos. 3 and 4 of the application, it is allowed and delay of 98 days in filing the appeal is condoned.
The application stands disposed of.

1. This is an appeal filed by the appellant against the judgment dated 05.05.2025 and order on sentence dated 16.05.2025, passed by the learned ASJ-07 in Sessions case no. 835/2018 titled "State v. Dharmander Singh & Saheb" in FIR no. 471/2018, registered at PS Hari Nagar, under Sections 376/366A/363/343/323/506 IPC and 6/21 of POCSO Act.
2. Admit.
3.
Issue notice.
Notice is accepted by learned APP who appears for the State.
4. Notice of appeal be also sent to the prosecutrix through the Investigating Officer.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 04/11/2025 at 22:51:28 5.
List in due course in the category of regular matters.
6. The trial court record in the digital format with proper bookmarking be also requisitioned.

sentences.text: This is an application for suspension of sentence and for grant of bail filed on behalf of the convict/appellant.

8. Vide judgment dated 05.05.2025, the appellant is convicted under Section 376(2)(n) IPC and Section 6 of POCSO Act and Section 66(E) of IT Act, 2000 and vide order on sentence dated 16.05.2025, he has been sentenced as under:

(a) Under Section 376(2)(n) IPC: Rigorous Imprisonment for Ten (10) years and fine of Rupees Ten Thousand Only (Rs.
10, 000/-).
In default of payment of fine, the convict shall further undergo Simple Imprisonment of two months.
(b) Under Section 66E of the IT Act 2000: Rigorous Imprisonment for two (02) years and fine of Rupees Ten Thousand Only (Rs. 10,000/-).
In default of payment of fine, the convict shall further undergo Simple Imprisonment of two months.
9. Issue notice.
Notice is accepted by learned APP appearing for the State, who seeks time to file the status report.
Notice be also sent to the prosecutrix through the Investigating Officer with direction to apprise the prosecturix of her right to have counsel from the legal aid at State expense.

10. Re-notify on 19.12.2025.
RAVINDER DUDEJA, J NOVEMBER 4, 2025 gs/ma
